payload.notes: Policy-compliant four-B70 record for DeepSeek V4 Flash K160. A new XPU Triton kernel reads the paged UE8M0 FP8 compressed and SWA caches directly, loops only over device-side runtime valid lengths, performs QK/softmax/PV in one graph-captured kernel per layer, and removes the BF16 staging workspace, packing operations, and output copy. It also applies the checkpoint's learned attention sinks, which the former XPU fallback accepted but ignored. The fixed realistic suite improved from 14.37840 to 21.54481 tok/s (+49.84%); p10 is 20.95058 tok/s. All 12 cold prompts reported cached_tokens=0, the strict gate passed, graph replay was persistent, and arithmetic/exact-copy/Paris/strict-JSON canaries passed. No speculation or reuse. K160 remains an experimental hash-pruned performance artifact, not an official-source quality-certified final pack.
